# immich_server_media_types (Data Source)

Retrieve all media types supported by the Immich server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_server_media_types" "media_types" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `image` (List of String) Supported image MIME types
- `sidecar` (List of String) Supported sidecar MIME types
- `video` (List of String) Supported video MIME types
